clubs.tacticsWhy: Against Motherwell (Dave.Sport): 66% possession, 92% pass accuracy, 26 shots (15 on target), 9 corners. That means short passing (2), a dominant style (off) and probably a high line (4, an estimate; no line-height data found). Kieran Tierney said after the match that the press and tempo were better. The second goal came from Høgh winning the ball back, and Baur's ball-win set up a 5-v-3 counter, so press 4. The full-backs push on and Tierney and Tounekti combined down the left, so width 4. Tempo 3: a possession side that moves the ball faster when it plays well. No PPDA, line-height or long-ball stats found. setAtt/setDef are neutral placeholders (no source).
clubs.desc: Celtic dominerer boldbesiddelsen med korte, sikre afleveringer, presser højt efter boldtab og angriber i bredden med offensive backer og tre kreative spillere bag angriberen.
uncertain: Who played right and who played left among Durán, Nygren and Tounekti is my inference, not stated by any source. Sky Sports and VAVEL list the team in the order Donovan…Tierney, McGregor, Baur, Durán, Nygren, Tounekti, Høgh (right to left). Celtic's own report says Tounekti and Tierney combined down the left. One Celtic report calls Durán a striker working alongside Høgh, so Durán may have played more as a second striker than as a right winger.
McGregor RDM / Baur LDM and Murray RCB / Scales LCB are inferred from the listing order.

Celtic switch formations: 3-4-3 in the 2026-09-20 league match vs Rangers (Carter-Vickers, Trusty, Scales at the back; McCowan in the front three). Carter-Vickers was not in the 11 October squad; I found no reason.

clubs.tacticsWhy: Three of Rangers' four goals in the Kilmarnock game came via the box: Naderi scored two headers, one from Penrice's cross. Kim and Gassama hold the width and Penrice overlaps, so width 4. Kelsy and Naderi play as a two-man front line with direct running into the box, so tempo 4. Naderi's pressing 'sets the tempo for the front line', but pressing dropped clearly in the second half, so press 3. The derby wins came from a compact shape (3-5-2/4-4-1-1) that 'contained' Celtic, not from dominating the ball, so style normal. Kilmarnock had more shots on target (6 v 4, Sky Sports). No possession, PPDA, line or long-ball stats found, so line and passing are neutral estimates. setAtt/setDef are placeholders (no source).
